title: SUPPLY AND SOURCING MANAGEMENT
description: Use of operations and supply chain management to make sourcing and supply decisions in international business contexts. Topics include purchasing/procurement procedures and policy, supply organization, specifications, sourcing strategy, supplier evaluation, competitive bidding, and e-procurement. Global contexts and environmentally and socially responsible supply management are emphasized.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 270 or 270H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 270 and BA 270H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Supply Chain & Logistic Manage (045) or Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075).
